reviews.comment: Great prof and super interesting class. She wrote the text book but she gives you pdfs. Lots of quizzes but everything is open note. Also if you're taking it online I recommend doing the final project as you go through the chapters.

Super easy class and would recommend for filler elective. Everything is unproctored. Assignments are tedious and can pile up very quickly, so don't wait until the last minute to do everything (if taking asynchronously).

It was clearly organized, but I thought it was more difficult than intended. It was frustrating when things were taken away, but I still got everything done. DO NOT wait to do things at the last minute.  SPELLING matters! Everything is open notes, which is a bonus!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: the class was fine ig, except for she didnt open anything until like march so there was no way to do any of the quizzes, test, projects etc. Leaving all of the work to be crunched into the last few weeks of classes. normally everything is open from the beginning and all due on the last day of class. The quizzes are unproctored but very tedious.
I took this class online, it was a lot of work but so much fun! The lectures were so interesting and I recommend it to anyone who is interested in forensics!

I just Q-dropped this class because 1: it was gross, I could not look at dead bodies and parts of the body, so seriously, if you are squeamish, do not take this class. 2: the class started Jan 16th but she shut everything down and did not open it until Feb 20th. Everything is due on the last day of class so you have to stay on top of the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: LOVEEE her! Wish I could take another class with Brundage!

Loved this class! Professor Brundage truly loves what she teaches, and you can tell! There's a lot of work so don't wait until the last minute to watch all of the lecture videos, but don't worry because they really are interesting! There's a Final Case study that includes work that you learn throughout the class which was actually my favorite part!

I only got a C because I forgot to take the final and the third test. There are open note quizzes for every chapter and weekly open note quizzes. The tests are open for a week. They are open note. There is a group project. It isn't that hard. She is really funny, and the class is really easy. Just do the work and you will get an A.

Professor Brundage was my absolute favorite. All assignments are easy and open note, and she provides enough information to finish them. If you have a question, you can ask her something before class and she'll be happy to help. The only difficult assignment was the final case analysis, but it was fine overall. Her lectures are so fun and amazing!

Look im all for easy open note tests, but a 200 question final? A final project that takes hours of mind numbing tedious going back through the slides to complete? Id honestly rather spend the time studying and take a regular length test. All of her tests are 100 questions or more. If you take her class, mind numbing busywork awaits!

Horrendous. Terribly long exams that the professors allowed everyone to take even though they acknowledged that the tables supplied were incorrect. Final exam consisted of questions of calculations never taught. Whole class is taught through recorded lecture videos, no supplemental materials. Learned nothing about insects related to forensics.

MY GOAT! she makes lectures easy to pay attention. tests are lengthy but they are open-book, online, and have a week to complete them. assignments are not hard at all. there are weekly quizzes and chapters quizzes, but they are not hard at all. since the textbook is written by her, it is also very fun to read and makes the topics more interesting.

Such a great professor, I strongly recommend. One of my favorite professors and the class is super easy. Everything is open note, untimed, and just literally perfect. I could not recommend Dr. Brundage enough.

Dr. Brundage is extremely funny, and her course is very organized. Tests are 100 questions, but they are open note and book, super easy. There are chapter and weekly quizzes, but they are not hard. I am not a forensics major, but I enjoyed this class, and it fulfills an LPS credit. Take her! You won't regret it.

My absolut3e favorite professor. If you have had Brundage for FIVS 205, you know what I am talking about. She is an absolutely amazing person ad professor. She will help you out whenever you need it, never had a problem in any of her classes. Very knowledgeable in ENTO and the projects are super easy.

I love Dr. Brundage. I wish she taught more classes. She's very helpful and extremely funny. If you do the work and put in a little bit of effort, you'll get an A. I highly recommend her class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she does iClickr during class, which counts for points. She really knows her stuff and tells stories about cases she's had.

Dr. Brundage is the best professor you will ever have. She is an amazing storyteller, inspirational lecturer, and the number-one voice fighting for the interests of the forensics program. Don't be afraid to reach out or go to office hours whether you need help in class, your life overall, or have questions anything entomology or forensics.

Though the online class was easy, the organization of the Reading quiz, Quiz Module, and Exams aren't the best in my opinion. Some questions that have not been discussed in the lecture videos and textbook may appear in these quizzes. Apparently, they have had this trouble for some time, so there's no circumventing it. The lab is also easy.
Gave great lectures and a lot of opportunities for extra credit, is not a hard grader at all (all tests including final are open note and open book) and she's really approachable.

I had to leave class early one day and next class she had me stay late just to check on me make sure I was okay to show just of how a caring professor she really is extremely smart extremely funny. Shes misspells a good bit but you be ok. Lots of assignments but spaced out to not be overwhelmed. Lots of extra credits

Class was great, participation graded by iClicker but she ends the questions quickly. There are a lot of quizzes but they're all pretty easy. The group project and the case analysis at the end is the hardest part.

This is a very fun and easy class. There is a lot of reading required, but I found the textbook not boring. For the most part, all assessments, and everything, are really easy. Don't skip class, she's uses iclicker and the information she gives in class can be very important, especially portaging to the exams.

The best professor at A&M hands down. All tests and assignments online and not proctored. She is so passionate about what she teaches and she educates you so well. Never saw her without a smile, I always looked forward to her class. The her over any other prof. for this class, you won't regret it:)

I took this class to fulfill my last Science Credit. The class is not difficult, but it is very homework and lecture heavy and in class participation is expected and graded. The homework mainly consists of quizzes over the textbook chapters. There is also one group project. The exams are open note and not timed as well which is great.

Very engaging class, lectures are enjoyable. Quiz before every class, but it's open book, unlimited time/attempts. Exams are also open book, online. Although this class does have assignments due every week, the workload is manageable as long as you stay on top of it. Group project and final case analysis at the end is the hardest part of class.

Dr. Brundage is a great professor and her lectures are so fun to listen to! Her class is very work heavy, but all her assignments are open everything and unlimited attempts. I recommend taking her if you need an extra science credit!

Great prof who offers a ton of extra credit. This isn't a blow off online class though so be prepared to actually do assignments. The worst part about this class is the 100 question exams and final case analysis but other than that great class. Definitely recommend if you are looking for a life and physical science credit.

Dr. Brundage is a brilliant scientist and a genuinely wonderful human being. Her class was honestly the best part of my day. Her lectures are HILARIOUS, and it's easy to absorb/retain the information because you are so engaged. Please, do yourself a favor and take her class. You will not regret it, I promise.

This class was fun to take! If you are interested in true crime at all, you will love it. It was self paced, unlimited attempts on many things like quizzes/assignments. There were some typos in the answer keys online resulting in test questions being counted wrong, but if you email her or the TAs they fix it right away. I really enjoyed it!

Professor Brundage is hilarious and engaging. The class is pretty easy, with open-note exams and lots of extra credit opportunities. I'd recommend using unstuck ai along with the textbook to ace this course. Overall, a great choice for an easy A!

This online was very much self paced. You receive all your assignments and exams on the first week and have until finals week to complete. There was a total of about 60 assignments including all the quizzes/exams. But if you just stay on top of the modules and the workload, you'll do great. Very easy and manageable class

Took her class over the summer. Everything was due on the last day of classes. Very easy to get an A. There is also so much extra credit, if you wanted to you could get well above a 100. If possible I would do this class over the summer because it is that easy, but take it now if you want to just have an easy A.

Dr. Brundage is such a great professor who obviously cares about her students a lot. She is hilarious and honestly made me want to go the the lectures, she keeps them very engaging compared to most professors I've had. The class is not too difficult but quite a lot of assignments.

A lot of content (when paired with lab), but 100% manageable and easy. Make a document with all of the quiz answers (it's allowed) and take them repeatedly until the questions start repeating. If you do this for all of your lecture quizzes, the exams will not be that hard. For 209, make use of the blank notes so that the exams are easy.

Her lectures were nice and occasionally had guest speakers bought in to take over class. Easy, unlimited attempt homework and quizzes. All you have to do is show up to class (attendance i-clickers) and you'll earn the easiest A!
Hilarious. Extremely qualified and obviously cares for her students.

This was a really easy class. Everything was due on the last day of finals, so you have the entire semester to get it done which was really nice. I waited until two days before and was still able to get it done, although it was a lot of work. The course is actually pretty interesting too and Dr. Brundage clearly has a lot of passion for her field.

Brundage is a phenomenal human and professor. Hilarious, caring, engaging, and the highlight of my day. Does IClicker each class (attendance tracker) so go to hear her lectures but also for your credit! She is so passionate about what she teaches and is very personable. TAKE HER!!! Exams are open note. Have some assignments, & chapter book quizzes.

Dr. Brundage is one of the most caring and funny professors I have ever had. Her lectures are super engaging. Going to her class was the highlight of my day. There are a lot of assignments but they are easy. As long as you do all the assignments it should be easy to get an A. I am going to miss this class.

Easiest class I have ever taken. She's a very knowledgable professor whose lectures are engaging and interesting. Assignments and exams are super easy but EXTREMLEY time consuming. Almost all the graded assignments are open note and open book. Definitley worth the time.
Dr. Brundage was by far my favorite professor from this semester. Her lectures were so engaging and entertaining. All of her exams are open note and book. Overall, easy A.

This was by far the best class I have taken while at TAMU. Dr. Brundage is an amazing lecturer and can keep her students engaged and interested in learning the materials. Would highly recommend taking this class if you can!

LOVE HER! The perfect professor for intro to forensics. She has so many stories and is great at keeping people interested in her lectures. She wrote the textbook herself and even that is interesting. A few quizzes over the textbook a week, so be ready to read, but everything is open note so it's not difficult.

One of the best Professor's I've ever had. I took this class at Florida State University in Panama City, and even though she's all the way in Texas, her lectures were amazing. She has a fiery passion visible in everything she talks about and clearly loves the area she's in. Her enthusiasm for the subject matter made the class amazing to be in!
I loved her. All her lectures were amazing and i actually liked listening to them. She does assignments over chapters but its pretty easy.

The professor was great; the class was good, but it was a lot, but all the quizzes and exams were open notes, open books, open whatever. The textbook is required. As long as you do your work, you'll be fine, there is extra credit, so if you need it, you'll get it. There is participation (iclicker) ~10% but answers don't matter as long as you answer

She has been the best professor Ive ever had. She inspired me to become a professor myself! I had my own business in the field I work in (mortuary science) and I decided to give it a go because I felt like if I could even be a fraction of what Dr. Brundage is I will make a difference in students lives.

I took this class online, and it was structured extremely well. Everything was open day 1, and everything was due Dec 14, and all the lectures were recorded, so you could do this class whenever you wanted. She didn't respond to emails in a timely manner and there were typos in the quizzes/tests, but the class was forgiving and very interesting.

Dr. Brundage gives the most captivating and engaging lectures you will ever have in college. Weekly quizzes and exams were open-note and open-book. Participation isn't taken but you are at a loss from listening to her stories and jokes if you don't go to class. Assignments are all easy, and the honors project (research paper) was fun to write.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Brundage is hilarious and I actually looked forward to her lectures for class. She tells stories and jokes in class but doesn't get too off track. There is a decent amount of homework but everything is fairly easy and online including exams. I took this for fun as an elective and 100% recommend it if you're interested in forensic science.

She was absolutely amazing. She's so funny and good at teaching and really made the class interesting. It was all online, so we were allowed to use our notes on everything, and the final exam also came with a final case study, and it was a little difficult but overall not too bad, it was really cool getting to do a case study. She's 10/10

Dr. Brundage's class was easy, offered extra credit, tests and quizzes were open-note, and her lectures were interesting. She does count attendance, and there is a required online textbook you need to buy, but otherwise the class was very easy and was an A as long as you put in the work. There are lots of assignments, mostly easy.

Professor Brundage was a great professor for this course. She is very passionate about this and her class is very well organized. All assignments due at the end of finals, so stay on top of it. Textbook required and very helpful. A lot of work but an A is very doable.

I took Prof. Brundage in a asynchronous class, and honestly I would recommend! There is a TON of work, but none of it is ridiculously difficult. Word of advice, if you actually read every chapter you will fall way behind on the work. It's interesting stuff, but it's just way too much. Quizlet will be your friend. An A is totally attainable.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: she is very kind and lectures are interesting. however if you're not a fivs or ento major (i took this class for a science credit) you might think the class is gross. she didn't count my attendance for a grade since i was sick multiple times from the content. she has lots of office hours as well. she gives LOTS of extra credit opportunities too

Best prof I had this semester by a mile. Super chill and genuinely LOVES the subject, I walked thru rain to west campus just to go to her lectures, thats how awesome they are. If you use her form to reach her she always gets back eventually. All assignments given at beginning of semester and due at the end. All exams open everything, easy A.

The funniest professor at TAMU. She genuinely cares about FIVS and is the literal real life Penelope Garcia from Criminal Minds. Makes lectures fun & engaging, always looked froward to going to her class. No due dates on assignments until very last day of class, so be careful not to wait until the end of the semester, or it'll all catch up to you.

This is literally my favorite class, and it isn't anything even close to my major. Dr. Brundage is the funniest professor I have ever had. There are quizzes embedded in the textbook that you have to do before lecture, weekly quizzes, and assignments every so often. There are 3 tests and a final case study. Everything you do is open note.

Great professor, easy class if you do the work. But she had many spelling errors on exams and assignments, which was frustrating because it'd often take weeks for her or the TA to correct. If you take her class online, be ready to make friends in it because it's extremely helpful when everyone else is also clueless.

Lectures keep ur attention bc shes so passionate about her class. Quizzes and exams are open note/book. Exams are fill in the blank and first 3 are 100 questions for 2 hours, final is 200 questions for 4 hours. It's a lot, yeah, but majority of the questions come from her chapter and weekly quizzes so make a study bank for those. Such a cool prof

Dr. Brundage is absolutely hilarious. There is not a professor like her on campus. She goes through her own case studies all of the time which has to be my favorite part about her class. You won't regret taking her class. You do have to buy her textbook though.

Extremely knowledgeable, charismatic, and passionate. Will make topics like blood spatter analysis, time of death estimation, and forensic entomology, not only tolerable, but interesting. Her demeanor is not for the faint of heart (or stomach), but is her sheer zeal for the subject matter she teaches that makes it impactful to every student.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Brundage was the best professor I had all semester. She is super funny and engaging and clearly cares about her students. Highly recommend.

I must have emailed Dr Brundage about 20 times this semester and not once did I get a response :( but still great professor. And easy interesting class, though the exams and lab exams are long!! I do recommend taking as an elective

Dr brundage is a good professor. She is very lively and passionate. The content is interesting, and the exams are very lengthy but not too hard as long and you do the quizzes/notes. However, I have not once been able to reach her and get a response through email. Very annoying. Overall, would recommend the class

For any forensics honors students, I beg you to please do not wait till the last minute for any of the honors project deadlines. This project is around two to three weeks of work, depending on what you choose to do, and it is very difficult to do last minute. There are also some group assignments that she will take mandatory attendance.

Literally one of my favorite teachers at TAMU so far. Even though I took ento 208/209 as an low-stress online elective, Dr.Brundage made me absolutely fall in love with entomology. Her lectures are really fun and will teach you sm. Grading is based on module quizzes, reading quizzes, and exams which is ALOT but its all due last day of the semester

she is a good professor and gives all assignments the first day of the semester so you have all semester to complete them. there is a lot of assignments so be aware of that. It is really hard to get in contact with her so you have to message the TA and she is not very helpful.
A LOT of assignments and weekly homework. Lectures are incredible but she does require attendance.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Brundage is a really sweet prof and made learning about insects fun! the class was asynchronous and pretty simple. Watch lecture videos, take quizzes, and exams. Exams are open note but also fill in the blank. Lectures are interesting but sometimes slides dont align with content. She can be hard to reach due to research.

Dr. Brundage is great! She made the lectures interesting and also told stories of her working in the field which helped me understand the material. There's a decent amount of homework and the tests are usually very long, but everything is open note. PSA: there are gory crime scene photos, so if you're squeamish proceed with caution.

You have to teach yourself in the course. There are no due dates and a majority of the assignments and your left fending for yourself when there are difficulties with assignments. The professor has never emailed us one, it was her TA the entire semester. The final exam was on material that we went over for two 15 minute lectures. Awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is a lot of work involved in this class. A reading quiz for each chapter due before each class, 11 quizzes, 9 assignments which are a little time consuming, and three 100/150 exams along with a final case study that is pretty deep. Dr. Brundage is amazing, so funny & kind, and makes all the work worth it though. Easy A if you put in the work.

dr. brundage is super cool! i loved her as a person. that being said, for non-forensics majors, this class did go above my head at times. it's graded out of 1,875 points, which can be your friend but can also make you struggle. i wouldn't take it again, but i got a lot out of it!

Grades are done by TA, you cannot get ahold of Brundage. So many spelling errors on quizzes and tests, frustrating that spelling was counted off when she can't even spell. 5 assignments, quizzes for every module (12), quizzes for every chapter (33), 3 Exams (200 questions), 1 final and 1 case analysis. Would not take again, although interesting.

Dr. Brundage is awesome and the lectures are seriously entertaining, however not mandatory because all of the material is in the textbook, which Brundage wrote herself. There aren't many assignments, but the only hard thing is the lengthy chapters and long fill in the blank tests. Would recommend taking this class for sure!
I really enjoyied going to my Fivs lectures and all quizzes and exam are open books.

Dr. Brundage is super amazing! Take her in person class because online it could seem overwhelming. Everything is open note for all tests and quizzes. Her lectures are amazing and she is very funny and entertaining. Everyone loves her class and I would definitely recommend it. Its an easy A and very interesting. Don't take if you get queasy!
If you take online lab be prepared to experience the most disorganization possible.

ENTO 481 is a writing-heavy course, but Dr. Brundage makes it all worthwhile! She provided individual feedback videos for each writing assignment and is really supportive of her students. As someone who was never a strong writer, I definitely became more confident. This course was a LOT of work for only 1 credit hour, so manage your time well!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I was not excited to take 208, but Dr. Brundage made the class so much fun and really made things interesting. She's such an awesome lecturer who truly cares about her students.

This class is a really easy A. The only downside is that the tests are super long and are all fill-in-the-blank. They are open-note and open-book though so there is really no reason to do bad on them , they just take a LOT of time. If you are looking for an easy BIMS elective take this class, the big tests are worth it.

Only take if you like 100 question fill-in-blank tests, getting answers wrong when you put the exact correct answer, or trying to sort through several confusing and scattered pages of information. Super nice and caring though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Pros: Easy A Cons: Amount of work - Three 100 question exams, one 200 question final, have to make a 10-12 minute podcast, 13 quizzes of varying lengths If you take this with the lab section as well, you're going to be spending quite awhile working on this course.

Dr. Brundage is one of the nicest professors Ive had but this class was way too much work. Although I was in the honors section, there were way too many assignments. Be prepared for a research paper, textbook quizzes, lecture quizzes, 3 exams, a final, a final case analysis and lets not forget about the hundreds of mistakes on quizzes & textbook!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is a covid-19 semester review. DO NOT TAKE HER UNLESS YOU WANT TO BE OVERWHELMED. She seems like a nice teacher but you have 35 10 question quizzes, 13 20 question quizzes, 3(fill in the blank) 100 question test, a 200(fill in the blank) final, a 62 final case analysis with so much information its impossible, and 5 very detailed assignments!
I think the course was very interesting. However, the final was 4 hours and 191 questions. It made me want to cry.

Dr. Brundage is really funny and seems nice. However, she is incredibly unorganized. There were tons of mistakes on quizzes and tests. The tests did not align with the lecture or reading. The tests and quizzes are open note. You can only email her through a form; I only received responses from the TA.

Somehow spent a good chunk of this class editing her answers, textbook, and submitting mistakes in her quizzes and other work. Don't know how this all wasn't looked over and fixed before the semester started. Other than that, a ridiculous workload. Her comments and teaching style is funny though.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Somehow this class was a genuine nightmare as full-online. The work is ridiculous, tests are insanely long and difficult for the time given, and just generally a bad class. I would've rather had an 8 AM every day than this.

This is a covid review, the whole class is online and unless you want to help edit the professors textbook for free and have a headache all semester-long regarding this class, I do not recommend . There are SOOOOOOO many grades and most of the quizzes in the textbook count right answers wrong and in order to get credit you have to fill out a form.

I hated this class. Her ability to develop on online class and deliver it to students is absolutely terrible. The syllabus, expectations, and information was hectic, outdated, and confusing. She overwhelmed us with impossible information. Look up all the answers on quizlet, ignore her chaos, and don't say you heard it from me.

This class online is super easy! There are 4 exams including the final and 12 quizzes plus a podcast project and book quizzes from the textbook. All the components of the lecture were easy and extra credit is also offered. Lab is easy as well as long as you study the specimens. 1st lab test closed note and the rest are open note!

ENTO 208 with lab is a super fun and interesting class. You really dive into a surplus of facts regarding all insects of veterinary importance. While I wouldnt say this class is hard, the tests were miserable and really only tested your ability to quickly look up facts in notes or quizlet (can use notes on Exams) because the amount of info is crazy

Dr. Brundage is incredible at her job, this woman really knows her material. She's actually hilarious and isn't afraid to speak her mind. The book doesn't necessarily need to be read before class but there are questions throughout that help on quizzes and tests. Just show up for attendance points and do homework and you will be fine.

Amazing class that was so interesting. The calculations can be difficult since it was online but if you watch her videos you will be able to figure it out. Beware of the final case study. It is worth a huge chunk of your grade and is pretty difficult and time consuming.
Hilarious, Caring, and actually interesting. Amazing class 10/10 wish I could take it again
Took Intro to Forens, Dr. Brundage is an amazing prof who you can tell loves what she does. I would take her again. I found myself wanting to attend every lecture just to hear her talk

Brundage is the best professor ever. She is hilarious and her lectures are very clear and to the point. She tells you everything needed for the exams, which are online, and the quizzes as well. 10/10 recommend this class. She is so funny!

Dr. Brundage is pretty cool, and the tests and quizzes are easy. You will be assigned a podcast and its through peerceptive which I experienced several difficulties on, so Im probably going to get a B in the class only because of that. Do not ever expect her to email you back. Literally not once.

The quizzes are pretty easy and all multiple choice, the exams however are fill in the blank. Luckily, with the online class everything is due at the end of the semester so you can go at your own pace, or do it all right before it is due like you said you wouldn't. Beware the podcast. Pick a good partner or honestly do it yourself if you can.

Dr. Brundage is the most awesome professor I've had. She's funny, caring, and she gives out a lot of extra credit. Tests are open book and online, the only thing you have to worry about is the fact that it's 100 questions in 60 minutes. Information is heavily lecture based, but the textbook she wrote is important too. Even the textbook is funny.
I loved everything about this class other than the podcast!!! Dr. Brundage is hilarious and very passionate about bugs!

This class required little outside work sense all of the test and quizzes are online. However, you do have to show up to class because she asks questions for participation points. Going to class isn't that bad because she does her best to make entomology interesting, and she is also super funny. One of my favorite professors for sure!

Dr. Brundage is a super fun prof! Her classes were always fun & she always had a joke to crack during lectures. She brought her dog once too. The class is pretty easy as long as you take all the quizzes & tests when youre supposed to. Definitely recommend!

I read a lot for this class. Brundage is awesome and makes lecture memorable. The test were probably the only difficult part as its 100 free response questions in 60 minutes. Do yourself a favor and make a goggle doc with questions from her weekly quizzes and write your own questions and answers from lecture. Fantastic class overall, learned a lot.
Definitely take any of her classes! If you don't get an A in her class then it's definitely because you were lazy and didn't even try. She's an amazing professor and a great person. Easy A

If you don't end up with over max points in this class, drop out of college. The only part of this class that sucks is the podcast project and the lab (ento 209). Study hard for the first lab exam (not lecture). Honestly, I did not enjoy this class in the slightest but it was an easy A. If you like this stuff, you will really like this class!
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of the best profs you can take. Class was crazy interesting and she knows a lot about the subject matter. She wrote the textbook and I genuinely enjoyed reading it. The exams can be tough because of time constraints but they're online and open note. Study a bit beforehand and you'll be fine. If you're looking for an interesting class take this!
The best professor at A&M. She writes her own textbook and her lectures are the most interesting ones I have ever sat through. This will be your favorite class

Brundage is such a great professor. I basically took this class for fun and I definitely had fun during her lectures. all her quizzes, tests, and assignments are online and are open note (a.k.a. quizlet friendly). However the tests are timed so its best to study anyways.

I LOVE HER!!!!!! Her personality is so bubbly! Class is usually 99% entertaining; the only boring days were with specific guest speakers. Brundage ALWAYS finds a way to make people laugh during lecture, and she shares REALLY good stories that correlate with a unit. Mind you most of the assignments are online, and they're all open-note!

This is a go at your own pace class. everything is due the last day of finals so you have to be able to do work on your own time. Lectures are VERY entertaining and she makes this online class fun! If you have a weak stomach do not take this class.

Dr. B is the skinniest queen at Texas A&M. I loved her class so much that I picked up a double major in Entomology. She's super passionate about her subject and it makes the lectures really enjoyable! All of the tests and quizzes are online and the podcast project is really easy. She also tells funny stories and sometimes brings her dog to class.

Dr. Brundage is a true QUEEN. This is my earliest class yet I am so into the lectures because of her! If you go to class for participation/attendance points and take notes, the online quizzes and exams shouldn't be a problem. There is a podcast project that you have to put time into outside of class but not hard to get done. Amazing professor!!!!!

I was skeptical about taking a vet class, because I am pre-med, however this class was amazing! I learned so much and the lectures were actually interesting. The quizzes and tests are online and they weren't bad, however the test are all fill in the blank and 100 questions so that was annoyed. Anyway, both lab and lecture for this class were easy.

Super easy class and very nice prof. There is a group project but it's not hard. Online is the way to go. Everything is due at the very end of the semester except the portions of the group project so its completely on your own time and won't interfere with your other classes. Lab is easy too, open book practicals just identifying bugs.

Dr. Brundage is a funny prof who will teach you a lot. For ENTO 298, quizzes and exams are online so you can find the answers but beware how long the exams are. There was one group project to make a podcast and if you're taking honors get ready to do a whole research project. Go to class for participation points and you won't regret it!
Great Professor, Hard tests but taken online, all information is covered in lecture, so as long as you take good notes this class will be a breeze
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was my favorite class. SHe makes it fun to learn but is still serious about it all. Her stories are the best, but be prepared for some images that are not for the weak stomached.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Brundage is very passionate about entomology. I was nervous to take this class but actually really enjoyed it. Amazing lectures, very entertaining. Easy quizzes per unit. Exams are easy but very time consuming. MAKE SURE SPELLING IS CORRECT! Gives extra credit but didn't end up needing it. Complete the podcast on time and should make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Brundage is absolutely amazing! She is very passionate about what she is doing! I did not like bugs at the beginning and ended her class able to stand bugs. Her lectures are hilarious - there will not be one day you dont laugh hard in class! Read the book and go over notes for quizzes and tests! You learn a lot and she makes it fun to learn!

She is a really great professor. If you don't have a slightly twisted sense of humor you may find her slightly disturbing. Also, if you can't handle dead bodies probably shouldn't take her class because she will show pictures. She does "quizzes" in class as like participation points and they aren't hard. Final exam is a case study/mock crime scene
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy class. All the quizzes/exams are online. You have to go to class for participation points, but her lectures are always interesting and really funny. There was a group project that involved making a podcast which was kind of annoying but pretty easy.

She is the ABSOLUTE BEST professor!!! Even if you aren't a forensics major, I swear you'll learn some interesting things! The class is so funny and she literally wrote the book you use and is very passionate and knowledgeable on the subject! DOOO TAKE! You have to keep up with the reading quizzes and the test are online and you can use your notes.

I took the online class, sat at a computer and finished everything in less than 8 hours. I did 14 quizzes total and 4 exams(with quizlet), my grade was above an "A" on those items combined. The only other thing was the podcast which has to be done with a partner, but in total over the semester we worked less than 10 hours and made an "A".
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Brundage is passionate about what she teaches, and her lectures are always funny and interesting. She's really laid back and easy to talk to. Tests and quizzes were online, and the majority of the material is talked about in class. She does go through material pretty fast in class so you have to read beforehand.

This class is interesting and I would definitely take Dr. Brundage again! She is very passionate and keeps the lectures interesting. The class is based on a point system with quizzes, assignments, 2 exams and one final that is cumulative. All of the exams are timed which make them difficult, but she offers extra credit.

Dr. Brundage is a super awesome teacher! Her test are online and kinda tough, so make sure you have your notes organized- and watch out for spelling. Lots of extra credit opportunities. She also cusses a lot so if you don't like that be aware. Grades in-class assignments really easily. The class is fun and entertaining and she is very passionate!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Brundage is a AWESOME professor! She makes learning about bugs not suck quite so much. Her exams are pretty long at 100 questions each but you can find all the answers online. You also have to make a podcast which is kinda weird but if you get a good partner it can be kind of fun. I would definitely recommend taking Brundage's class.

Dr. Brundage is super funny! you have to go to class to get the attendance points and the notes. she also offers multiple opportunities for extra credit! you have an online quiz each week that you can take multiple times. tests are also online. it's a lot of work but you'll get an a if you put it in the effort
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Brundage is an amazing prof. Her lectures are interesting easy to follow and pay attention too and she is hilarious. She wrote her own online textbook so you know what she is talking about. She is also a forensic entomologist and she always has great stories.
Just don't take any class by her. Save yourself. She's unreachable outside of class, not prepared, changes deadlines constantly, and does not answer emails reliably.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is a wholesome prof. Bugs aren't everyone's thing, but she does a good job keeping class interesting and relevant to what you'll see in an Ag career. There are quizzes every week & 100 question exams, but a lot of the info is online or covered in lecture. There is a group project which was a bit unorganized this semester, so maybe it'll improve

BEST PROF I'VE HAD AT TAMU SO FAR. She is hilarious and knows her stuff. Exams were online as well as the quizzes. No homework but she does do in class quizzes that count for attendance. Super easy and what you learn in lab matches up with lecture.
Incredible professor, amazing time in class. Hands on, and lectures. Funny.
Best professor I've had. Hilarious and is passionate of about the subject. Loves her students and will mesmerize you with he lectures.

All I have to say is that if you are looking for an easy class, take Entomology with Brundage. All quiz and exam questions can be found on the internet and I only went to class to get attendance and participation points. Lab is also pretty easy. Not to mention, Brundage is hilarious. Def recommend!!

She is an incredible and caring professor. If you actually go to class and take notes, then you will have literally all the answers for the quizzes and tests. She throws in questions where the only place to find the answer was in her lecture, so watch out. But the lectures are so entertaining that it's worth it to go, plus she takes attendance.

LOVED DR. BRUNDAGE!!! She is so funny and VERY excited about bugs. Don't take this class online because then you'll miss out on Brundage! The class was actually interesting and all tests and quizzes were online but timed. Don't bother buying the book, it's way too detailed. Overall great class, but the honors project was pretty intense.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This class was genuinely interesting, straightforward &easy. Online quizzes that aren't too bad. Exams were online but were exhausting to take. Got 2 hours to do a 100 question test, and had to spell everything correctly. There was a group project that was required where we had to do a podcast. Lab is required & in person but really easy as well.

Dr. Brundage is one of the best teachers I've ever had (including before high school). Her lectures are entertaining and she is clearly passionate about the material. You need the textbook for quizzes and exams. Exams are all online, open book and open note. Only problem with this class is answers on exams and quizzes can't be misspelled at all.

While she is an amazing lecturer and very knowledgeable, she makes the class so easy that you don't even have to show up. (But you should because you get points just for going) Textbook is a waste of money because all the quiz answers are online. Take the Practice Exams because they are the actual exams. You have to try to not get an A.

This was my favorite class this semester and Dr. Brundage makes it very enjoyable. The class itself it not very difficult and she provides many opportunities for extra credit. The only downside to this class is that attendance is mandatory and it is recorded through a program called tophat. It is a giant pain, but it does help the lecture.

She is a really good professor and makes everything interesting to learn about. She really knows how to grasp your attention with quirky stories. The only downside of this class was that the exams were online and were very picky with the answers. If you answered in the plural form instead of singular, it's wrong :(
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Literally one of the best professors I've ever had! She makes lecture interesting and fun! Quizzes online every week, you'll do well if you do the assigned reading! Tests are online, they aren't terrible but pretty time consuming (100 questions), but she gives hints in class of possible test questions etc!  LOVED HER!!!!

Dr. Brundage was the best professor I had this semester. Her lectures were always interesting and fun. She loves to joke around, which made lectures even more fun. However, she also knows when to be serious on certain topics we went through. Assignments, quizzes, and exams were all done through eCampus and she offered extra credit as well.
Dr. Brundage is an amazing teacher! I was not looking forward to learning about bugs, but she really made the class fun! She loves what she does and wants to see students succeed!

Dr. Brundage is extremely passionate about bugs. She makes a subject that would normally be super boring seem super interesting because of her enthusiasm. Tests and quizzes are online. Quizzes aren't a cake walk, you actually have to read the assigned reading, but the tests are the same questions from the quizzes. Would love to take her again.
She is so awesome. Very lovable and very funny. SHOW UP TO CLASS!!!

My favorite professor by far! Weekly quizzes come straight from lecture and book (so buy it, cheap on Amazon), she drops the lowest one, and the exams are the quizzes word for word. Highly recommend, and absolutely no reason not to get an A! The course is cool on its own, but she makes it even cooler.

One of, if not the best, professor at Texas A&M University. Extremely funny, very likable and shows a huge amount of passion for the subject she's teaching. I enjoyed her class so much that it was one of the few that I actually looked forward to attending.

Dr. Brundage is by far my favorite professor here at A&M. While I am only a freshman, she will be tough to beat. Even when she's talking about the parts of forensics you may find boring, she still manages to constantly crack jokes and keep your attention! Her tests are exactly like the practice tests online. Easy class.

Dr. Brundage is so nice and she's so cool. You don't have to go to class but if you do it is usually pretty entertaining. She's always open to help you. She put a practice test online the day before the test and they are very very very helpful (DO THEM) I got a 100 on the first test. Gives multiple assignments but none are that hard. Easy A.

Dr. Brundage is absolutely amazing! She made me so passionate about forensics (my major) and prepared me well for my future. Will definitely be staying in contact with her! She makes coming to class enjoyable! She's super sweet and helpful in office hours, and a very very fair professor. Absolutely loved being in her class! Would take again!!

Dr. brundage is freaking amazing, I only came to exams and lectures once in a while and passed with an A, do the online quizzes and read the lectures online and you'll be golden. But it is worth going to lecture she brings in live insects and always has awesome stories she is the BOMB

AMAZING!!! She is one of the funniest teachers I know!! She is passionate about ENTO. I only went to class on the test days and the very first day of class I passed with an A easily. All you have to do is your online quizzes and practice test the exams are exactly the same as the practice exams. And all the answers are online :) You got this!!!

She makes it very easy to pass with an A as long as you do the quizzes on time, which are really quite simple honestly. She then posts practice exams the night before the test which are literally the exact questions she will use for the exam. Take the practice test multiple times in order to see the most amount of questions that could be used. Easy

Dr. Brundage is so wonderful! Her lectures are interesting, and she supplements them with fun stories from her experiences in the field. The quizzes and tests are straightforward, and the assignments are pretty fun. An A is achievable in this course if you're willing to put forward the effort. She genuinely cares about the success of her students.

Probably the funniest professor I've had so far! The class is an easy A if you put some effort into it.  Go to class because there are random days when she gives extra credit just for being there, and a lot of her weekly quiz questions are questions from lecture.  Her tests are a breeze because she pulls them out of a test bank online!
Dr. Brundage is by far my favorite professor at Texas A&M! I really want to take another one of her courses in the future!!!

Very Energetic. Loves her job and Forensics in general. You will never fall asleep in her class. She will share so many personal stories about cases and fun facts that makes the class fun. She provides extra credit randomly in class, so make sure you're there. Exams are not cumulative and questions are pulled from a test bank which is on ecampus!

This class was actually pretty interesting for 8 am! She is energetic and upbeat so its a nice learning environment. Quizzes are word for word from the lecture and book so going to class is a must. The lab is pretty easy too just pay attention.

Loved her as a teacher - very quirky and fun!  She is passionate about the subject and she shares lots of really neat facts about it.  Weekly quizzes are great to make sure you understand the material - they are online, so open note!  Tests and easy - taken straight from questions off the quizzes (she also gives you a study guide to fill out)
She is fantastic. Easily one of the best professor at A&M. Take her if you can or you will be missing out!

Dr. Brundage has no dull moments in class. Her grades stem from the weekly quizzes, exams and extra credit. If you're unsure about getting that grade you want then TAKE THE EXTRA CREDIT. It help me get the grade I wanted. Pay attention in class because the quizzes require some recollection. Great class to be in. She is awesome. Enjoy her class.

Awesome professor! She is has a lot of experience and tells loads of cool/funny stories about the stuff you are learning, which makes you remember the material.  She gives extra credit. You basically just have to try and attend class to do well. Definitely recommend.

She's the best forensics teacher in all the land :) I was really scared to take this class because I am not into forensics at all, but she's seriously so cool and fun that it doesn't matter. I've never missed a lecture because she's that interesting!
Great teacher! Keeps you interested, gives you so many chances to get a good grade. She does not accept anything late, but she gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Take this class!
She rocks my socks!
